name: ai-netcontroller
description: AI NetController — Network Workstation Fleet Manager, Wake-on-LAN Orchestrator & Remote Diagnostics (Beta 0.50.00)

scripts.start: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const res = spawnSync(process.execPath, [require.resolve('tsx/cli'), 'apps/web/server.ts'], { stdio: 'inherit', env: { ...process.env, NODE_ENV: 'production' } }); process.exit(res.error ? 1 : (res.status ?? 1));"
scripts.build:releases: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const py = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'python' : 'python3'; const res = spawnSync(py, ['scripts/build_release_binaries.py'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(res.error ? 1 : (res.status ?? 1));"
